strategies.title: QKV two-level tiling with L1 reuse
strategies.summary: Use bidirectional Q and KV two-level tiling so K/V tiles are reused across multiple Q microblocks, reducing repeated GM to L1 traffic. This strategy is the prerequisite structure for later pipeline overlap.

issues_found: AP-002: Q Outer Block State Cache Pollution

added_sections: 6.5: Q Outer Block State Cache Reset

strategies.title: Multi-buffer soft pipeline after two-level tiling
strategies.summary: Add TQue multi-buffering and PRELAUNCH soft pipeline on top of verified QKV two-level tiling to overlap movement and compute. Requires the two-level L1 reuse structure to already be present.
